nodes.title: 🌸KiraNugget's Multiview Character Sheet🌸
widgets_values:
❤️Thank you for trying my workflow!❤️
------
This workflow will recreate your input image in a professional multiple angles character sheet. Perfect for project where you need consistency.

Like and comment on civitai if you like this workflow. I would love to see your work! 

Also don't hesitate to comment you suggestions or bug reports!

Have fun!

-----

___
💡TIPS:
-
- Loras apply only for the first Front View generation, but all the other images are based on that front view output image. Useful for artstyles and sliders.
- You can give specific instruction to each generation.
___
___
⚠️RTX UPSCALE⚠️:
-
- Will upscale your base image size by 2X.
- Require an NVIDIA GPU with RTX compatibility. Having it will generate 4k images (2160 x 3840 or 3840 x 2160). Disabling it will still give you quality HD results. (1080 x 1920 or 1920 x 1080)
___
___
⚠️GENERATION NOTES⚠️:
---
- YOU are responsible for both input and output images in this workflow; I take no responsibility on what you do with it.
---
___
___
